# ConvMixer

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/convmixer.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/convmixer.py) ·
**Architectures:** 3 · **Pretrained weights:** 3 (3 with ImageNet-1k results)

ConvMixer embeds the image as patches and keeps that resolution throughout, alternating depthwise convolutions (spatial
mixing) and pointwise convolutions (channel mixing).

## Papers

* [Patches Are All You Need?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.09792)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('convmixer_1024_20_ks9_p14.in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```
